title: API: an untracked part is created with or without bins
custom_preconds:
• Signed in to the app; API calls replayed from DevTools against the API host with header X-Location-ID = your location.
  • A category id (catId) and a non-default bin id (binId) for the location.
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/inventory/parts/create with partNumber QA-UNTR-1, description "QA loose bolts", categoryId catId, cost "1.50", quantity 0, bins [], tags [], isFixedPrice false, isTracked false (other fields null).
  2. GET /api/inventory/parts/{part_id} for the new part.
  3. POST create again with a new partNumber and bins [{id: binId, quantity: 3, isDefault: false}], isTracked false.
  4. GET that part.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • 201 with isTracked false.

Step 2:

  • isTracked false, isActive true, binLocations empty.

Step 3:

  • 201 (no default bin is needed for an untracked part).

Step 4:

  • binLocations has the bin with quantity 3, isDefault false; quantity 3.
